notes.title: Crimson Core Update
notes.content:
GOOOOOOOOOD MOOOOOOORRNIIIIIINNNNNGGGG!

It's been a while my fellow gamers. I apologize about not updating in two years but my life has been extremely busy. This also means I have been hard at work on Crimson Core adding new mechanics as well as updating stuff people suggested after playing the early Dev Demo.

If you haven't played the early Dev Demo, please give it a try and let me know what you think on twitter!
[url=https://twitter.com/arcticfox223]My Twitter[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/CrimsonCoreGame]Crimson Core Official Twitter![/url]

Game Development is at 69.2%
Accomplishments:
+Fishing has been added. 
+Sprites have been updated.
+Battle Sprites are currently being updated.
+New in game areas have been created.
+New cutscenes involving static (pictures) and nonstatic animations. 
+New enemies have been created.
+Story has been updated to reflect directional changes.

More to come!

Here's a clip of the updated battle battle sprites:
[url=https://twitter.com/arcticfox223/status/1634381004684050439?s=20]Twitter Video[/url]

You can follow me on twitter for more updates.
